The model failures tend to be inconsistent application of rules, like that the word “se” is pronounced “he” after a vowel (this alternation is described in the phonology section of the grammar and reflected in the additional parallel sentence data, but the model may be confused by the fact that the underlying “se” form is used as the gloss throughout the examples within the grammar), or lack of reflection, like that the word “kabor”, although it is defined as “to be full” in the dictionary, is only used for stomachs/hunger in all examples of its use. 18
